long_biography.plain_text:
Raised and educated in Macau, Steven Lo Kit-Sing began at a Portuguese bank before moving into European car distribution, property and department-store operations. After returning to Hong Kong, he entered cinema ownership and production, then established BMA Entertainment in 1998. The company built businesses around recording, artist management, films, live events and later catering and leisure.

Football became another public-facing strand of his career: Lo led South China's football management committee, and an official association report later listed him as a board special adviser. His record also includes a Macau conviction. The Court of First Instance found him guilty in absentia of active bribery and money laundering over a land transaction and imposed a five-year, three-month sentence. The Intermediate Court rejected his appeal; Lo denied wrongdoing.
